articles.summary: Sourcify's legacy v1 API has been deprecated for a while. v2 has been the primary, recommended API for over a year: async job-based verification (no more hanging requests), richer responses (storage layouts, source maps, transformations, proxy resolution), clearer naming (exact_match / match instead of the confusing "perfect" / "partial"), and it's already serving 15M+ requests/day.
articles.title: API v1 Brownouts: Time to Move to v2
